evidence.reason: The current `publish` path still cherry-picks each repair commit onto the current target with no conflict handling (`wt_git(wt, 'cherry-pick', sha)`). For non-open-PR runs the target can be a moved `DEFAULT_REF` tip, so a conflict raises; `harvest` catches any publish exception at current lines 317-322 and records `publish_failed`, which is the state the finding says is re-entered on later ticks. There is no current conversion of this conflict into `stale`, so the retry loop described remains in the pinned code.
